observation: The qualified 43414-record original window compares 470 motion prefixes, 470 inhibited returns, 19 A0 speed commands, 567 sprite vectors, 548 field vectors, 2445 sine and 2445 cosine lookups, and 10921 committed width-based sprite-PC stores. All 82 corruption cases are rejected, and every one of 66 artifacts equals the independently built uninstrumented control.
interpretation: The original sprite A0 command supplies signed scaled speed, a source-table vector routine preserves the original shift/wrap order, and the ordinary field wrapper quantizes X/Z to sixteenth units. The sprite PC store uses its post-handler pointer and the original unsigned width table. Full active motion and remaining sprite handlers/loop paths remain unreconstructed.
author: Codex /root, independent original-source and execution analysis on 2026-09-08

preconditions: Exact selected original Disc 1, pinned Nix shells, original-data imports and fresh private outputs.
Reuse the existing field23-control-observation route and memory sampler, with no new setup writes.
Reuse or reproduce the fully qualified party-loader capture from EVID-REF-022; keep read-only instruction probes separate from the independently built uninstrumented control.
commands: Run the same original scenario with --trace-instructions <planar-spec> and a fresh private output directory.
env PYTHONPATH=. python .local/analysis/phase1-planar-motion-20260908/audit-planar-v2.py <fresh-version> (set capture paths for new runs)
validation.expected: Exact source identities, input-derived arithmetic, complete shared captured bytes, pointer storage, original return/stack/order relationships and committed stores. Reject corrupted evidence and preserve the full independent control.
validation.actual: 43414 records qualify without guard mismatches, unavailable ranges, exhausted budgets or collector failures. Every compared stage matches. Eighty-two corruption cases are rejected and all 66 control artifacts are exact. Sixteen synthetic arithmetic, branch and index-boundary tests pass.
validation.tolerance: Exact signed integer and byte/hash equality. Shared state sets are explicit; no inferred mask for field-resource mutations, no host-generated trig table, no inferred no-op handlers or universal cadence.

unobserved_source_branches: Different A0 operands, signed scales, rate controls and packed divisors; zero-divisor hardware behavior.
Ordinary field direction sentinel, descriptor-bit-clear ratio path, alternate actor/ratio/Gear paths.
Non-owner active motion prefixes, alternative airborne old-mode choices and complete motion-counter/collision semantics.
Other sprite opcodes/widths, command effects, frame/pose/wait branches and field source index0 command execution.
limitations: 470 complete active motion bodies and 11516 other VM loop entries remain opaque. Their presence is counted, not decompiled.

Only 50 compared PC stores use party resources; 10871 use four field-indexed resources. Source indices and used opcode bytes qualify, but 68 other runtime field-component bytes differ and remain unexplained.
Source-width stores do not implement handler semantics; missing rows in opaque VM paths are rejected by whole-capture fingerprints and original callback counts, not by invented handler rules.

The additional field actor range supplies branch input but is not captured at every non-player return. Shared captured state, nested sprite stores and original pointers are exact; uncaptured memory is not claimed compared.
Ground sprite speed is not final collision-resolved displacement or universal per-frame cadence. Full motion, floor/layer/ceiling/rollback/history/follower/camera and readiness remain required.
All 15 broad Phase 1 todos and nine slice proof domains remain open; independent review and native gameplay remain unimplemented.
